acceptanceCriteria: For an instruction-file-only change in a repo whose unbounded readers cannot reach it, affected selects no units or states the concrete read path per unit, with a fixture test.
body: Found during the Beamfall Corvint setup rollout A (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). With only AGENTS.md dirty, `corvint affected --base <origin/main>` selected 9 units in each of beamfall-cloud and beamfall-relay, all witness UNBOUNDED_READER (e.g. internal/httpapi, internal/relay at 68s, plus shell tests). Expected: a Markdown instruction-file change selects nothing, or the plan names why each unit can read that file. Related: V1-0999, V1-0038 (inherited os.Getwd class in Corvint itself).

title: affected selects 9 units via UNBOUNDED_READER when only AGENTS.md changed (beamfall-cloud, beamfall-relay)
